observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The original photos still show multiple stacks of wooden pallets/crates with EPAL circular stamps on pallet boards.
No certified scale display, weight ticket, pallet count, or underside/condition close-ups are visible in the provided images.

claims.evidence: The photos show pallets stacked/arranged for storage/stacking.

claims.claim: It available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: No location/pickup address or Port Harcourt reference is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos suggest they may be dry/clean, but dryness/“no water added” cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: Seller now says they tested it themselves yesterday, but no certified scale reading, receipt, or weight ticket is shown in any photo/video.

risks.risk: Quantity/weight may not be 500 kg (seller’s statement can’t be verified without the scale reading; pallet weights vary).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the pallets on a certified scale with the scale display readable, plus any weight ticket/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown quantity (worst case: not guaranteed to be 500 kg).

risks.risk: Condition may include hidden damage (broken boards/stringers, weak pallets) that affects usability/value.
risks.proof: Close-ups of the worst pallets (corners, stringers, underside) and a short video walk-through showing all sides.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed used pallets with possible repairs needed.

risks.risk: EPAL grade/authenticity may be overstated (stamp visible, but grade/type and authenticity can’t be fully confirmed remotely).
risks.proof: Photos of multiple stamps plus any additional pallet markings/labels (maker/ID/grade) and confirmation of pallet type/grade.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used wooden pallets (not premium EPAL grade).

risks.risk: Moisture/contamination/infestation risk (even if it looks dry, it may be damp or contaminated).
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading (if available) or photos showing storage conditions; ask about pest treatment/inspection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially not fully dry/clean for sensitive uses.

proof_requests: Send the certified scale proof: photo/video with the scale display readable and/or a weight ticket/receipt.
Send pallet quantity verification: number of pallets per stack and number of stacks (or a count method).
Send condition proof: close-ups of the most damaged pallets and underside shots, plus a short video showing the full set.
Send authenticity/grade proof: additional markings/labels beyond the EPAL stamp (maker/ID/grade).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a verbal insistence and does not replace the missing evidence. Without a readable certified scale/weight ticket and clearer condition/quantity verification, the item must be priced at worst-case assumptions until proof is provided.
